The exact logarithmic six-equation becomes Lz+delta(e^{-z_{j-1}}-1-eta h_j)+O(delta^2). L has kernel at sixth roots (m=1,5) and invertible complement. Lyapunov--Schmidt reduction gives (2/3)[sinh q+sinh(q/2)]=eta; its monotonicity ensures unique q, and P D shift^{-1} is invertible since the compressed positive diagonal multiplier is positive definite and shift preserves kernel. Analytic IFT gives actual positive orbits and O(lambda^{-1}) accuracy, unique by global attraction. The finite-lambda susceptibility follows by linearization. The standalone exact-Fraction and numerical checker returned VERIFY_OK; its finite cases are not used as an infinite proof.

value.rationale: The theorem answers a natural singular-forcing question for a globally attracting nonautonomous delayed population system: a vanishing O(lambda^{-1}) seasonal carrying-capacity profile produces an O(1) nonconstant orbit because the limiting six-step memory operator has a genuine two-dimensional kernel. The exact nonlinear amplitude and its cubic and logarithmic regimes resolve a critical resonance that is invisible to ordinary pointwise perturbation at fixed growth, giving a structural boundary beyond mere known-average recomputation.
